UPDATE:
Crews have found a broken high side disconnect lead feeding half of Daniels Harbour and all or Portland Creek. An emergency outage request for all of Daniels Harbour, Bellburns, and Portland Creek will be issued (approximately 289 customers) from 4:00pm to 5:00pm to correct this issue. The current customers out of power have a restoration time of 5:00pm. The additional customers during the upcoming emergency outage will also have an estimated restoration time of 5:00pm.

Newfoundland & Labrador Hydro wishes to advise its customers of an Emergency Power Interruption; Tuesday, October 6th, 2026 from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM This power outage will affect the customers in: Daniels Harbour, Portland Creek & Bellburns. Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro apologizes to its customers for any inconvenience this outage may cause. We appreciate your understanding as we work to maintain safe and reliable infrastructure.

NEWFOUNDLAND AND LABRADOR HYDRO IS ADVSING CUSTOMERS IN THE COMMUNITIES OF DANIELS HARBOUR AND PORTLAND CREEK OF AN UNPLANNED POWER OUTAGE.  HALF OF DANIELS HARBOUR AND ALL OF PORTLAND CREEK IS WITHOUT POWER. THE CREW IS ON ROUTE TO INVESTIGATE. THERE IS NO ESTIMATED TIME OF RESTORATION.
properties.Title: Under Investigation
